title: Untethered Microgrippers for Biopsy in the Upper Urinary Tract.
authors: Liu, Wangqu; Alam, Ridwan; Choi, Si Young; Wan, Yan; Zhang, Ruili; Baraban, Ezra; Matoso, Andres; Matlaga, Brian R; Winoker, Jared S; Gracias, David H
one_liner_zh: 该文研究用于上尿路活检的微型夹持器，属医疗微机器人应用，与蛋白质-DNA互作及AI/物理模拟方法完全无关。
abstract: Untethered microrobots offer the possibility to perform medical interventions in anatomically complex and small regions in the body. Presently, it is necessary to access the upper urinary tract to diagnose and treat Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma (UTUC). Diagnostic and treatment challenges include ensuring adequate tissue sampling, accurately grading the disease, achieving completeness in endoscopic treatment, and consistently delivering medications to targeted sites. This work introduces microgrippers (micro-grippers) that are autonomously triggered by physiological temperature for biopsy in the upper urinary tract. The experiments demonstrated that micro-grippers can be deployed using standard ureteral catheters and maneuvered using an external magnetic field. The mu-grippers successfully biopsied tissue samples from ex vivo pig ureters, indicating that the thin-film bilayer springs' autonomous, physiologically triggered actuation exerts enough force to retrieve urinary tract tissue. The quality of these biopsy samples is sufficient for histopathological examination, including hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) and GATA3 immunohistochemical staining. Beyond biopsy applications, the micro-grippers' small size, wafer-scale fabrication, and multifunctionality suggest their potential for statistical sampling in the urinary tract. Experimental data and clinical reports underscore this potential through statistical simulations that compare the efficacy of micro-grippers with conventional tools, such as ureteroscopic forceps and baskets.
abstract_zh: 无系绳微型机器人有望在解剖结构复杂且狭小的人体部位执行医疗干预。目前，进入上尿路以诊断和治疗上尿路尿路上皮癌（UTUC）是必要的。诊断和治疗挑战包括确保充分的组织取样、准确分级疾病、实现内镜治疗的完整性，以及持续向目标部位递送药物。本研究引入了由生理温度自主触发的微型夹持器（micro-grippers），用于上尿路活检。实验表明，微型夹持器可通过标准输尿管导管部署，并利用外部磁场进行操控。微型夹持器成功从离体猪输尿管中获取了组织样本，表明薄膜双层弹簧的自主、生理触发驱动产生的力足以取回尿路组织。这些活检样本的质量足以进行组织病理学检查，包括苏木精-伊红（H&E）和GATA3免疫组织化学染色。除活检应用外，微型夹持器的小尺寸、晶圆级制造及多功能性表明其在尿路统计采样方面的潜力。实验数据和临床报告通过统计模拟强调了这一潜力，该模拟比较了微型夹持器与传统工具（如输尿管镜钳和取石篮）的效能。
